name: Muktagacha

queries.query: Muktagacha Bangladesh official cadastral map land records parcel GIS
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the Department of Land Records and Surveys online settlement/map viewer, the official DLRS map-purchase portal, the Ministry of Land portal, and the Muktagacha Assistant Commissioner (Land) local office page. The official public map viewer exposes administrative and survey-selection routes, but no anonymous Muktagacha parcel geometry was returned in the bounded requests.

Bangla first-party discovery found the DLRS settlement portal, the official online Mouza-map purchase service, Ministry of Land land-information services, and the Muktagacha local land-office citizen charter. The local page refers to records, deeds, sketch maps and land services, but no public parcel polygon or safe parcel-ID response was found.

officialSources.observation: Current official DLRS settlement portal links to Khatian records, map display, search and survey services; it states that displayed records may be draft survey records.
Current official DLRS integrated map-purchase portal describes searchable CS, SA, RS, BRS and BDS Mouza maps by division, district, upazila and Mouza.
Official Muktagacha Assistant Commissioner (Land) citizen charter identifies local land-record, deed and sketch-map evidence/procedures and the local office.

parcelDiscovery.note: No parcel polygon or safe native parcel identity was returned. The exact WUP point was preserved and not shifted; the absence of a point hit is not treated as evidence of citywide absence.
